hooks.name: Spec task end: test evidence, RAPLH log entry, human review
hooks.description: Requires real test evidence and a genuine RAPLH_LOG.md entry after each spec task, then asks for human sign-off.

action.prompt:
Task finished. Before calling it done:
1. Run `python .kiro/scripts/loop_guard.py` and show the real pass/fail summary.
2. Append one entry to docs/RAPLH_LOG.md labelled "Genuine record" with: the task and expected outcome; a summary of the instruction given to the AI tool; the files changed; the test command and its actual result (copy real numbers, never invent them); what was corrected; approval decision "PENDING human review".
3. List the changed files and ask the human to review and approve (H step). A task is only complete with passing tests, test or demo evidence, and human sign-off.
